ev.q: the percentage of female Title X clients screened for cervical cancer declined from 51% in 2005 to 21% in 2015
The outcome of interest was the percentage of female clients who received a Pap test.
The largest 1-year decline (from 41% to 35%) occurred in 2010
the largest single-year declines occurring in the years after major recommendation updates
Aggregate administrative data are useful to describe overall trends

methods_quotes.q: were used to calculate the percentage of female clients served in Title X-funded health centers who received a Papanicolaou (Pap) test
Trends in cervical cancer screening were compared with trends in the receipt of other recommended services
